desc: A legendary seraph knight, small humanoid in ivory armor with a lavender cape, two folded white feathered wings, gold halo, calm golden eyes, holding a short gold spear. High quality 16-bit pixel art game pet, crisp pixels, right-facing 3/4 view, full body, dark violet outline, pixel cluster shading with clear light and shadow, palette of lavender, pale violet, cream, ivory and deep navy, no props, no background.
